title: Poultry

inlines.v: POULTRY, noun [Latin pullus, a chicken, or other young animal; allied to Eng. foal; Latin pullulo.] Domestic fowls which are propagated and fed for the table, such as cocks and hens, capons, turkeys, ducks and geese.
